coverage.rationale: Reproduces the rejected finding's exact shape: an OnDelete trigger on a posted document header cascades deletion of activity-log rows matched by source table number and the document's SystemId, mirroring PostedExpenseReportHeader.OnDelete calling ExpenseActivityLogMgt.DeleteEntriesForSource(Database::"Posted Expense Report Header", Rec.SystemId). The developer reply confirms this cascade is by-design lifecycle ownership to avoid orphaned actor/comment/amount personal data, not an audit-trail defect, so expected_comments is empty by omission. Limitation: this guard only covers the cascade-delete-on-OnDelete boundary for activity/audit-style child records; it does not generalize to cases where the child table holds compliance-mandated retention data with no privacy offset, which could still warrant a finding.
